title: Dominic and the Autopsy
author: Y. M. Coldharbour
blurb: Emrys Dunmore, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the trial begins.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
